name: ingenus-mcp-bridge
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Ingenus MCP server: read-only contract and SAP checks. Proof of concept on synthetic data.
long_description: A thin bridge with no tools of its own: it signs you in to Microsoft once, then forwards Claude Desktop requests to the central Ingenus MCP server, where the read-only tools and guidance live. It cannot change SAP or any file. Phase 1 v1 proof of concept by Psiog; synthetic data only.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The Ingenus MCP server address. For the local test: http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp. A server on the network must use https://.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID (sign-in)
tenant_id.description: The directory (tenant) ID of the organisation that signs you in. Fill in all three sign-in fields, or leave all three empty for a local demo server that has sign-in off.

client_id.title: Desktop client app ID (sign-in)
client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the Ingenus POC Desktop Client app registration.

server_client_id.title: Server app ID (sign-in)
server_client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the Ingenus POC MCP Server app registration.
